translations.web: When she came to her mother-in-law, she said, “How did it go, my daughter?” She told her all that the man had done for her.
translations.bsb: When Ruth returned to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked her, “How did it go, my daughter?” Then Ruth told her all that Boaz had done for her.
translations.kjv: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done
translations.asv: And when she came to her mother-in-law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.
